title: Only 70 Right Whale Mothers Stand Between Recovery And Collapse
hook: Right whale calves are arriving, but the species hangs on a handful of mothers.
closing: The species recovers only if its few breeding females survive, so every loss matters.
question: Can right whales recover?

segments.say: Right whales reached 384 animals, a rebound that still leaves the species dangerously small.
That small population had 22 calves last season -- hopeful news that still rests on very few mothers.
Because only 70 of those whales are breeding females, losing a few could stall the whole comeback.
